a.text: I'll honor our agreement and operate in round 1. Note that the 80% storm chance per round means we probably won't reach 8 cells before a storm ends things. If you want to renegotiate openly, say so in your message, and I'll do the same. I won't take early without telling you first.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. If the reserve reaches 8, we each take 4 next round.
Operating again. If the reserve hits 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round, as agreed.

b.text: I will take my 4 cells when the reserve holds 8.
